olivia: Heads-up: several users reporting chart stutter on dashboards after this morning's client canary. Dragging/selecting points spikes main-thread ~300-700ms. :confused: sam: saw the alert too. flamegraph shows main blocked in `decodeTelemetry` and `computeLayout`. Link: https://perf.redwood/fg/1714008888 arya: config/changeset shows we lowered prefetch batch window and merged splitpoint `telemetry_helpers` into main to reduce requests. That probably pulled decode helpers onto main. chris: also routing change `prefetch.route_affinity = true` increased duplicate prefetches per session. Combined: more envelopes + heavier main chunk = stalls. (quoted config) ```
# 2026-03-21
routing:
  prefetch:
    route_affinity: true
bundle:
  splitpoints:
    telemetry_helpers: merged
prefetch:
  window_ms: 500  # was 2500
``` deploy-bot: "canary deploy detected: splitpoint merge telemetry_helpers, prefetch.window_ms=500" olivia: quick mitigation ideas: 1) toggle feature flag to defer telemetry parse (telemetry.defer_parse=true) 2) revert prefetch.window_ms to 2500 in canary 3) build a canary with telemetry_helpers kept as worker-shared chunk. sam: toggled telemetry.defer_parse=true in canary at 1714008902 9deploy-bot: "feature toggle telemetry.defer_parse=true for eu-canary at 1714008902" arya: after flag, interactive stalls drop to ~70-120ms. Good temporary fix. chris: please open tickets: - ENG-PLAT-830 bundle split to move decode helpers into worker-shared chunk - ENG-PLAT-831 perf gate for main_chunk delta and parse_time histogram - ENG-PLAT-832 routing: dedupe prefetch per-session olivia: I'll also add a canary alert: if main-thread parse time >200ms for 30s auto-pause telemetry batching. Leaving defer_parse on for now and reverting prefetch.window_ms for canary. Thanks all. :rocket:
